title: Account Verification

messages.text: Reminder: Routine system checks will run this week. No steps are required unless notified through the Employee Portal.
Your profile requires immediate verification. Confirm your details to prevent access interruption: https://nexatrust-authconfirm.com/update

explainPoints: Verification claim: SMS B falsely demands 'immediate verification' of your profile. SMS A simply reminds about routine system checks with no action needed.
Login/update link (nexatrust-authconfirm.com): SMS B contains a fake domain asking to 'confirm details'. SMS A states notifications come through the Employee Portal.
Access interruption threat: SMS B uses scare tactics warning to 'prevent access interruption'. SMS A has a calm, informational tone with no threats.
